create_fuyu_for_causal_lm: create a FuyuForCausalLM model from pretrained weights for image-conditioned text generation
build_fuyu_model: build a FuyuModel with vision backbone and language model without language modeling head
run_fuyu_forward: run the FuyuForCausalLM forward pass with image patches and text input_ids for training with labels
get_image_features: get image features from pixel values using FuyuModel.get_image_features to produce patch embeddings
generate_fuyu_text: generate text from FuyuForCausalLM conditioned on input images and text prompts
